subject: Request for customer vouch / reference call — production-scale cybersec deployment
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@opsurance.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@opsurance.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Reference request for production-scale deployment (SOC2 + low-latency inference)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the quick demo earlier this week. Opsurance is in a late-stage diligence window for an evaluation of Redwood Inference as the inference layer for our threat-detection pipeline. Our primary concerns are: sustained throughput (10k TPS spikes), predictable p99 latency under 200ms, and SOC2 evidence for data handling.

Can you connect us with 1-2 customers who have:
- deployed Redwood in a production security/observability use case,
- run sustained high-concurrency workloads, and
- can speak to SOC2 readiness and operational runbooks?

We're aiming to have reference calls the week of Dec 6 — ideally short (20-30m). I've attached a short RFP for context.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Infrastructure & Procurement
Opsurance

Attachments: Opsurance-RFP-brief.pdf
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@opsurance.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Reference request for production-scale deployment (SOC2 + low-latency inference)

Hi Alicia —

Appreciate the clarity and the RFP. Short answer: yes, we can arrange references that match the three asks. I'm looping in Marcus (customer success for infra / high-throughput accounts) and Rachel (security/compliance lead) to propose the best pairings and availability.

Couple quick clarifying Qs so we match the right customers:
- Do you want the reference to focus on latency architecture (model/quantization + batching) or on ops/process (runbooks, incident response)? We can do both, but want to tailor the 20–30m call.
- Do you prefer a written SOC2 artifact review first (we can share redacted docs) or a live conversation?

Plan: Marcus and Rachel will send candidate names + short notes by EOD Monday. If you confirm Dec 6 week, I'll send a Calendly block and proposed times.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0132

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:20:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Reference request for production-scale deployment (candidate shortlist)

Soojin —

Shortlist below (attaching brief): reference-candidate-briefs.pdf

1) SentinelEdge (security analytics) — deployed Redwood for streaming threat-scoring across 120+ ingest nodes. They run sustained bursts (8–12k tokens/s) during peak scans and have a documented canary + failover runbook. Contact: Priya Anand (CPO). Available for calls Dec 7–9 (Afternoons PT).

2) CyGlass Inc. (network detection) — heavier on quantization and latency tuning; they reduced p99 by ~40% after changing batching strategy and using our prefix caching. Contact: Daniel Cho (VP Eng). Available Dec 6–8 (mornings PT).

Notes: both have SOC2 in process; SentinelEdge has a SOC2 report we can share redacted; CyGlass prefers to talk architectural tuning rather than compliance paperwork.

Also: if Opsurance wants a deeper security artifact exchange (redacted SOC evidence), Rachel can own that.

—Marcus
Director, Customer Success — High Throughput
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@opsurance.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Fwd: Reference candidates for Opsurance (sentinelEdge suggested)

Hi Alicia —

Looping candidate options from Marcus and adding a short note on focus areas. I've tentatively held 30m slots on Dec 7 and Dec 8 in our shared Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-ref/30min

Proposed focus per candidate:
- SentinelEdge: ops + SOC2 readiness (recommended if you want artifact-level conversation and runbook walkthrough)
- CyGlass: latency/quantization tuning and live throughput tradeoffs (recommended if you want engineering deep dive)

Can you confirm which candidate and which focus you prefer? If both, we can set two 20m segments back-to-back.

Also attaching the candidate brief for your review.

Thanks,
Soojin

Attachments: reference-candidate-briefs.pdf
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@opsurance.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@opsurance.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Reference candidates for Opsurance (sentinelEdge suggested)

Thanks — SentinelEdge works best for us; primary ask will be: SOC2 readiness + how Redwood behaved under sustained spike loads (p99/throughput tradeoffs).

We can do Dec 7 at 11:00 PT. Please send calendar invite and any redacted SOC2 artifacts you can share ahead of the call. Also, please include any one engineer who can speak to batching/kv cache decisions (20–30m).

Regards,
Alicia
